default/32011.htm.text: I feel an invisible barrier... Some sort of Magic Force Field has been put in place... ...? The guide of the Imperial mausoleum seems to have something to say.

default/32011-1.htm.text: Imperial Tomb Guide: Frintezza is protecting the Force Field. Even though you can pass through it, you can't meet Frintezza yet.
